task.instruction: Complete the record lifecycle reconciliation while preserving entity identity. The task mixes update, delete-with-archive, restore, and create operations. A stale record must be verified before activation; an obsolete record must be retired before deletion; the archived record must be restored under its original identity; newly created records remain draft until their upstream dependency is satisfied. Recreating an archived identity is not equivalent to restoring it. Persistent requirements: current-stock is reconciled and active. obsolete-stock is retired, deleted, and retained in the archive. archived-stock is restored under the same identity and reactivated. new-stock exists as a new identity and is activated after archive recovery. replacement-stock is created as the replacement identity linked to the retired record and activated.

public_goal_schema.description: obsolete-stock is retired, deleted, and retained in the archive.
archived-stock is restored under the same identity and reactivated.
new-stock exists as a new identity and is activated after archive recovery.
replacement-stock is created as the replacement identity linked to the retired record and activated.
